meta.name: hyperframes-keyframes
meta.description: Use when a HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or `hyperframes keyframes` diagnostics. Don't use for broad scene strategy, brand design, media sourcing, captions, or general video planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 HyperFrames 合成添加安全的关键帧动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 HyperFrames 中制作精确的 2D/3D 关键帧动画
copy.tagline_en: Add seek-safe keyframe animations to HyperFrames compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need precise 2D/3D keyframe animations in HyperFrames

howto.what: 当你的 HyperFrames 合成需要安全的 2D/3D 关键帧、GSAP 时间线、CSS 关键帧、Anime.js、WAAPI、FLIP、路径、遮罩、SVG 变形/绘制、文本轨迹、3D 深度或关键帧诊断时，Claude 会生成并验证这些关键帧。
howto.when: 当你提出一个 HyperFrames 合成需要上述类型的关键帧（例如 2D/3D 动画、GSAP 时间线等）时触发。不要用于场景策略、品牌设计、素材寻找等。

say.text: 用 GSAP 给我做一个小球弹跳的动画。
say.note: Claude 会生成 GSAP 关键帧并注册时间线。

say.text: 用 CSS 关键帧让这个元素淡入。
say.note: Claude 会编写 CSS 关键帧并设置动画属性。

say.text: 检查一下我写的关键帧是否有问题。
say.note: Claude 会运行诊断命令检查错误。

howto.what_en: When your HyperFrames composition needs seek-safe 2D/3D keyframes, GSAP timelines, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, FLIP, paths, masks, SVG morph/draw, text trails, 3D depth, or hyperframes keyframes diagnostics, Claude generates and validates them.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request a HyperFrames composition requiring any of the listed keyframe types (e.g., 2D/3D animation, GSAP timelines). Not for scene strategy, brand design, or media sourcing.

say_en.text: Make a bouncing ball animation with GSAP.
say_en.note: Claude generates GSAP keyframes and registers the timeline.

say_en.text: Fade in this element using CSS keyframes.
say_en.note: Claude writes CSS keyframes and sets animation properties.
Claude runs diagnostic commands to find issues.
